gaps.item: Due today list (T2 rows, R56 review row, words, day's questions, challenge, contests, own-task checkbox, Skip/Move/Mark done/Swap, Why, results, Fix the N it opened)
gaps.source: spec/v2-upgrades/today.md T2; spec/rebuild-v2.md §3.2.3 3b; product.md G1/R56
gaps.evidence: GET /api/today .due for the seeded learner (5 plan tasks today) and for a new learner is review.due's shape {subject, cap, items, kinds, forecast, ...} with no `rows`. The page reads due.rows, so #due reads 'Nothing due yet today.' for both at 1280 and 390. Cause: server/api_today.py today_payload uses `_call('next','due') or due_fallback(...)`. next.due (F2) returns review.due's payload, so the T2 rows builder due_fallback never runs. Side effect: a new learner's #chal is hidden because Due has no challenge row, so Today offers no way to start the daily challenge.
gaps.build: In today_payload, build /api/today.due from due_fallback (T2's rows with R56's review row), or have next.due return {rows, minutes_left, goal_minutes, done, total}. Keep review.due for the review row's items. Check: seeded plan day gives rows starting ['plan',...,'review','words','qotd','challenge'], and a new learner gets 3 rows (0 of 3).

gaps.item: Up next session plan: numbered blocks with × drop, alt 'Or a timed module' row, plan_note, value-first reason line, and question 1 answered in place (first token), including G10's 'Start with 8' block with its inline question
gaps.source: today.md T1 (Screens, Data and endpoints, acceptance 1-5); product.md G10 'On Today'
gaps.evidence: POST /api/drill/preview {source:'next', box:15|count:22, timed, drop:[]} returns the builder preview keys (available, servable, count, templates, ...) with no `blocks`, `first`, `reason`, `alt` or `plan_note`. /api/today.next.preview has the same shape. grep of server/*.py finds no preview_seed, preview_secret or preview_stale. On the page, #next shows only the coach's topic chips and 'about 24 questions at your pace', with no block rows and no inline question, for both the new and the seeded learner.
gaps.build: F5: /api/drill/preview for source 'next' (and 'start') returns blocks [{key, kind, label, detail, count, minutes, pts, topic}], minutes, alt, plan_note, reason and first:{token, question} (preview_seed walk, HMAC token in kv preview_secret). POST /api/drill accepts first:{token, answer, ms} and returns {id, feedback, next_url}, or 409 preview_stale. The page code (paintBlocks, paintQ1) already renders these fields.

gaps.item: Starts on Today that fail: Up next lead 'Sharpen · 12 q', Score's 'Sharpen · 12 questions', every Pace-card drill, causes 'Clock' speed drill, plan 'Map' task, grid-in extra 'Practise · 10'

gaps.evidence: POST /api/drill {count:8, timing:'pace', source:'pace'} → 422 'choose from builder, challenge, coach, due, ...' (no 'pace'). {source:'probe', count:12} → 409 no_templates, although insights.estimate.thin lists 2 domains. {formats:['spr'], count:10, source:'gain'} → 409 no_templates. Make probe with no topics fill from estimate.thin domains (U5), and let a formats-only set with no topics draw from all servable grid-in templates. S7/F2: give the plan's map task a task id the drill accepts, or accept ':map'. Check: each body above returns 200.

gaps.item: Up next item 2: an unfinished drill leads with 'Continue · N of M answered' (+ timed '· 6:10 left', topic chips, '+N more unfinished sets')
gaps.source: spec/rebuild-v2.md §3.2.3 3a item 2, acceptance 24; today.md §3.2 row 'shell-me U1 next.queue' (adds kind resume for an unfinished drill)

The page's leadFrom already renders these fields and the '+N more' link.

gaps.item: Up next item 1: a running timed test shows 'Module in progress · 14:22 left · 9 of 22 answered', a ticking clock, 'The clock keeps running while you're away', and a Resume pill (or 'Time's up' with Continue to module 2 / See results)
gaps.source: spec/rebuild-v2.md §3.2.3 3a item 1, acceptance 19
gaps.evidence: After I began a timed module and answered 3 questions, next.items[0] = {kind:'resume', title:'Resume module · 3/22', detail:'3 of 22 answered', href:'/test/?s=…'}, with no timed or seconds_left. #next shows 'Resume module · 3/22' and an orange 'Start' pill, with no time left and no helper line. The same payload's open.test has seconds_left 2099, and #tests shows '34:58 left'.
gaps.build: F2 next.queue: emit the running sitting as kind 'test' with timed, seconds_left, answered, asked, module, section and action ('Resume', or 'Continue to module 2' / 'See results' when seconds_left is 0). Page leadFrom: title 'Module in progress' / 'Section · module 2 in progress', and fall back to S.t.open.test when the queue row has no clock.

gaps.item: Final stretch (T13 modes stretch/taper/eve/exam/after): hero '· final stretch' chip, #exam moved full width, rehearsal lead, readiness rows, countdown additions, sweep row, 'Light warm-up' on the eve, exam-day card order, no new rare skills
gaps.source: today.md T13 (acceptance 1, 4, 5); §3.1 entry 21/24
gaps.evidence: For exam dates of today+12, +6, +1 and 0, /api/today.next.stage is next.py's shell stage {name:'test'|'final', days_to_exam, final_week, eve}, with no `mode`, rehearsals, sweep or rare. The page keys every T13 behaviour on stage.mode. At +12 the hero reads 'SAT in 12 days' (no final stretch), #exam stays in the side column, and the reason line reads 'New skills, the biggest domains first'. On the eve Up next reads 'Rest. Nothing new today.'. On exam day Up next leads with 'Start with 8 questions' and #exam is not the second card. Cause: api_today.stage() returns _call('next','stage') first, so its own T13 builder is unreachable.
gaps.build: Have api_today.stage() compute T13's {mode, days, rehearsals, sweep, rare, scores_by} itself and merge F2's name/final_week into it, or add `mode` and the T13 fields to next.stage. Then check T13 acceptance 1, 4, 5 and 7 (no untried/probe items in the stretch, 'Light warm-up' on the eve, #exam second on exam day, both #mist groups).

gaps.item: Recent tests data: diagnostic gate, miss chips per module (wrong vs blank), open sittings, total, kind=tests and paging from /api/history
gaps.source: spec/rebuild-v2.md §3.2.3 §11 'Diagnostic not signed up for', Review change 17; today.md §3.1 entry 32 (history rows carry modules, gated)
gaps.evidence: GET /api/history?kind=tests&all=1&limit=6 returns every finished drill with only {id, kind, started, finished, right, asked, estimate, topics, label}: no modules, gated, total or next_offset. Check: the gated diagnostic's card reads 'Sign up to see your results' with no band and no Fix.
